title: Market Pulse Terminal market snapshot
description: Single source of truth for the snapshot returned by GET /api/market and pushed on the GET /api/stream 'snapshot' event (SRS §6). schemaVersion 1 keeps every field added after the reference build optional, so reference-compatible static snapshots and replay fixtures stay valid. Backend models and frontend types are generated from this file (AGENTS.md §5); never hand-edit the generated output.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Removing or renaming a field needs a version bump, a migration note and an update to the static-export fallback (AGENTS.md §5).

fetchedAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 time the snapshot was built (FR-8).

indexes.description: Header index cards in display order (FR-19).

gainers.description: Top gainers, best first (reference shows up to 10 rows).

mostActive.description: Most active by volume, with the day range needed by row tooltips (FR-25).

sources.description: Section to provider name, recording which provider supplied each section (FR-6). Keys are section names such as indexes, movers, news, status, sentiment; values are provider identifiers such as yfinance, alpaca, finnhub.

status.description: Per-section freshness. A failed refresh keeps the last good data and marks the section stale; it never blanks the section (FR-9, AGENTS.md rule 5).

feedDelaySeconds.description: Delay of the slowest contributing feed, disclosed in the footer with the provider list (AGENTS.md §12).

errors.description: Non-fatal problems recorded while building the snapshot; empty when everything succeeded.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601, always Z-suffixed. Convert to the user's locale only in the frontend (AGENTS.md §5).

symbol.description: An index symbol with a leading caret (^GSPC) or a US ticker.

price.description: Positive price; invalid rows are dropped before the snapshot is built (AGENTS.md rule 6).

changePercent.description: Percent change. The bounds are a plausibility guard, not a filter; mover thresholds live in movers_filter (FR-7).

change.description: Absolute change for the session, signed.

invert.description: true for VIX: a rise is coloured as a fall (FR-21, AGENTS.md §7).

sparkline.description: Normalized intraday series, about 140 points; may be shorter when history is thin.

isProxy.description: An ETF (SPY, QQQ, DIA, IWM, VIXY) standing in for an index. Added after the reference build, so optional; the backend always emits it (AGENTS.md rule 7).

asOf.description: Time this card's data was last good.

verdict.description: Band containing position, or UNKNOWN when fewer than three components are available (docs/sentiment.md §4).

position.description: Mood score, 0 very bearish to 100 very bullish (FR-10).

summary.description: Deterministic template text, or an LLM summary when ENABLE_LLM_SUMMARY is on (FR-12). May be empty.

headlines.description: Up to five headlines (FR-11); empty when the news provider fails.

components.description: The components that fired, with effective weights summing to 1.0, so the UI can explain the score (docs/sentiment.md §3). Added after the reference build, so optional; the backend emits it on every snapshot.

then.description: Fewer than three components cannot produce a directional verdict (docs/sentiment.md §4).

score.description: 0 very bearish to 100 very bullish. Computed as a float internally and rounded half-up on output.

weight.description: Effective weight after renormalising over available components; the exposed weights sum to 1.0.

volume.description: Session volume. On free Alpaca this is IEX-only, which understates the consolidated market.

section.description: Section that failed, for example indexes, movers, news or sentiment.

provider.description: Provider that produced the error, when it is known.

message.description: Short message. Never contains keys, tokens or account identifiers (AGENTS.md rule 2).

sectionStatus.description: fresh: refreshed within its cadence; stale: last-good data retained after a failure; error: no usable data for the section.
